features: Day and night operation with built-in infrared LED illuminator
Integrated PIR (Passive Infrared) sensor for motion detection
Micro SD/SDHC card slot for local video recording
Simultaneous H.264, MPEG-4 and Motion JPEG compression
10/100 Mbps fast Ethernet plus Wireless N Wi-Fi
Built-in microphone and speaker for 2-way audio

frigate.notes: D-Link RTSP path is typically /live1.sdp (some older models use /play1.sdp or a MJPEG CGI) — verify in the camera web UI.

home_assistant.notes: Generic camera via the MJPEG/RTSP URL (no ONVIF documented).

blue_iris.notes: Use 'Generic/ONVIF' or the D-Link RTSP URL.
